prompt_text: A 5-second static close-up, looking down at an angle into a shallow round gray pot with two ball-ended handles, filled with smooth pale aquafaba on a bright white surface. As the liquid boils, bubbles break the smooth surface and form rounded pale foam clusters, first in patches over part of the surface. Over about the first half of the clip, the patches grow and merge until dense froth covers nearly the whole surface inside the rim. For the rest of the clip, the foam layer keeps heaving and rearranging from the boiling underneath, staying inside the pot with no overflow. The pot, the background block and the camera do not move.
